intent.summary: Ship Rubrix v1.5.0 — /goal as convergence runner.
intent.details: v1.5 redefines what Rubrix automates. Up through v1.4 the contract enforced the front half of the loop (rubric → matrix → plan lock) and required a human to manually call /rubrix:score every turn for the back half (Scoring → Passed | Failed → revise plan → re-score). Claude Code v2.1.139 added /goal — a session-scoped Stop-hook wrapper whose small-fast (Haiku by default) evaluator reads the transcript every turn and decides whether a condition holds. /goal cannot call tools; it only sees what was already printed. That shape matches Rubrix's PlanLocked-onward lifecycle exactly. v1.5 ships a read-only /rubrix:goal skill plus a `rubrix goal print|validate` CLI sub-command that synthesizes a 4000-char-capped transcript-evaluable termination condition from the locked rubric/matrix/plan + adds an optional `goal` artifact to the schema (additive, fail-open on pre-v1.5 CLIs) so the chosen condition + its derived contract hash can be persisted for audit. PR #4 later adds the goal-aware handleStop reason and the `## /goal status` report section that surfaces overall_pass + state into the transcript for the next-turn evaluator to read.

criteria.description: `skills/goal/SKILL.md` triggers only when state ∈ {PlanLocked, Scoring, Failed}, runs `node cli/bin/rubrix.js goal print rubrix.json`, and presents the CLI output inside a fenced ```text block prefixed with the literal `/goal ` for copy-paste; never mutates rubrix.json (the skill is read-only); refuses with explicit `/rubrix:plan` redirect when state is pre-PlanLocked. The synthesized condition is always ≤4000 chars, leads with the verdict markers `rubrix gate`/`overall_pass`/`state: "Passed"`, and trims criteria with weight-descending ordering plus a `(+K more — see rubric.)` tail if needed.

`cli/src/commands/goal.ts` exposes two sub-commands: `rubrix goal print <path> [--json]` synthesizes a condition (returns exit 0 with the condition on stdout, or exit 3 if state is not PlanLocked/Scoring/Failed); `rubrix goal validate <path> <condition> [--json]` reports exit 0 when the condition fits in 4000 chars + contains at least one of {`rubrix gate`, `overall_pass`, `Passed`} + has no filesystem-read directive (matched by /\bcat\s+rubrix\.json/i, /\bread\s+the\s+file/i, /\bopen\s+the\s+file/i, /\breadFile(?:Sync)?\b/i), exit 3 otherwise with concrete reasons on stderr (or in `issues[]` with `--json`). Output stability: the synthesized condition's `derived_from_contract_hash` is deterministic for byte-equal rubric/matrix/plan and changes when any of them does.

`cli/schemas/rubrix.schema.json` adds top-level `goal` as an optional object with `required:['condition','max_chars']` and `additionalProperties:false`. `condition` is a string of length 1..4000; `max_chars` is the integer constant 4000; `suggested_condition` is an optional ≤4000-char string; `derived_from_contract_hash` is an optional /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/ string. Top-level keeps no `additionalProperties:false`, so a v1.4-installed CLI reading a v1.5 contract with `goal` set still validates clean (fail-open invariant — same pattern that v1.3 dogfood relied on). Adding `goal` does not require any new state-conditional clause.

`cli/src/core/version.ts` exports `isV15Plus(c)` mirroring the existing isV12Plus/isV13Plus/isV14Plus pattern: returns true for `1.5.0`, `1.5.99`, `1.6.0`, `2.0.0`, `1.10.0`; returns false for `1.4.99`, `1.4.0`, `1.3.0`, `0.1.0`, invalid semver, and zero-padded forms; the helper never throws at the boundary (`try/catch` around parseVersion). Existing isV1XPlus helpers remain byte-equivalent in behavior — no regression on the lower-bound helpers.

`synthesizeCondition` survives pathological paths: when the standard `header + tail` form exceeds 4000 chars (extremely long contract path), the function emits a markers-first compact form leading with `overall_pass: true` and `state: "Passed"` so any tail-side hard-truncate cannot strip the verdict markers. The pathological branch is covered by an explicit test using a 4500-char path. Conditions remain non-empty and ≤4000 chars in every code path.

`checkCondition` uses word-boundary anchors in its forbidden patterns so legitimate prose containing the substring `cat` (e.g. `concatenate rubrix.json`) is NOT rejected. A dedicated regression test asserts `checkCondition('Verify that we did not concatenate rubrix.json ...')` returns zero filesystem-read issues. Existing positive rejections (`cat rubrix.json`, `read the file`, `readFileSync`) remain rejected.

`synthesizeCondition`'s `derived_from_contract_hash` is byte-equal whether the rubric/matrix/plan are absent (key not present) or explicitly `undefined`. The function normalizes undefined artifacts to `null` before canonicalize() so JSON.stringify-driven key dropping cannot bifurcate the hash. Covered by an explicit equality test in goal.test.ts.

`.claude-plugin/plugin.json` and `cli/package.json` both carry `version: "1.5.0"`. `claude plugin validate .` exits 0. No other version-string references in repo (README, CLAUDE.md, PLUGIN-README.md, VERIFICATION.md, docs/extensible-plan.md) still claim the old version after this PR is merged; the 5-doc set is consistent.

Root `rubrix.json` walks IntentDrafted → RubricDrafted → RubricLocked → MatrixDrafted → MatrixLocked → PlanDrafted → PlanLocked under the v1.5.0 schema branch with brief calibrated, evaluation_policy fully populated, drift_policy populated. `rubrix state get rubrix.json` prints `PlanLocked`. `rubrix validate rubrix.json` exits 0. The `goal` artifact block stays absent in this PR (PR #4 will fill it after dogfood Passed).

An installed v1.4.2 plugin CLI reading the v1.5.0 root rubrix.json validates exit 0 (the `goal` artifact branch and any v1.5 surface stay additive — top-level has no `additionalProperties:false`, the schema's clauses don't gate on isV15Plus, and pre-v1.5 CLIs ignore the `goal` field). Verified by `node ~/.claude/plugins/cache/rubrix/rubrix/1.4.2/cli/bin/rubrix.js validate rubrix.json` exit 0.

`cd cli && npm test` reports zero failed and zero skipped tests. Baseline ≥614 (post-PR-#2 merge) is preserved. PR #3 adds at minimum two new test files (`version-v15.test.ts` ≥12 cases, `goal-schema.test.ts` ≥9 cases) totalling ≥21 new cases without any existing test relaxation, `.skip`, or `.only`.

`cd cli && npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit) exits 0 with zero TS error lines after the v1.5.0 PR #3 changes are applied; `cli/src/core/contract.ts` GoalArtifact interface + `cli/src/core/version.ts` isV15Plus addition + `cli/src/commands/goal.ts` (unchanged from PR #2) all conform to the package's strict tsconfig.

rows.evidence_required: skills/goal/SKILL.md frontmatter contains `name: goal` and a description whose trigger clause names all three allowed states (PlanLocked, Scoring, Failed) and explicitly excludes pre-PlanLocked. Body has Preconditions/Steps/Worked-example/Postconditions sections. goal.test.ts asserts (a) goalPrintCommand on a PlanLocked contract returns exit 0 with stdout containing `rubrix.js gate`, `overall_pass`, `state: "Passed"`, and the per-criterion floor markers; (b) Scoring and Failed states also accepted; (c) IntentDrafted and PlanDrafted refused with exit 3 + stderr mentioning required state; (d) condition is ≤4000 chars; (e) weight-descending ordering of criteria; (f) (+K more criteria — see rubric.) tail when trim is needed.

goal.test.ts has both a `goal print` suite (≥8 cases including --json output with derived_from_contract_hash, criteria_count, criteria_included, suggested_for_state) and a `goal validate` suite (≥7 cases: accepts valid condition, rejects empty / no keyword / cat rubrix.json / read the file / oversized, --json round-trip). Deterministic-hash test asserts byte-equal hash for the same contract called twice; hash-changes-on-rubric-mutation test asserts the hash changes when rubric.criteria[0].floor changes.

goal-schema.test.ts asserts (a) v1.5.0 contract without goal validates; (b) v1.5.0 contract with well-formed goal validates; (c) max_chars != 4000 rejected; (d) condition > 4000 rejected; (e) empty condition rejected; (f) goal missing required max_chars rejected; (g) goal with unknown property rejected (additionalProperties:false); (h) malformed derived_from_contract_hash rejected; (i) v1.4.0 contract carrying a goal still validates (fail-open invariant).

cli/src/core/version.ts contains `const V1_5 = "1.5.0"` and `export function isV15Plus(c: Pick<RubrixContract, "version">): boolean` mirroring isV14Plus. version-v15.test.ts asserts 12 cases: true for 1.5.0, 1.5.99, 1.6.0, 2.0.0, 1.10.0; false for 1.4.99, 1.4.0, 1.3.0, 0.1.0, invalid semver, zero-padded forms; isV12/13/14Plus unchanged on a 1.5.0 input.

goal.test.ts `synthesizeCondition pathological cases` describe block has an `extremely long path` case (path = 'x'.repeat(4500) + '.json') and asserts: (a) result.length ≤ 4000; (b) condition contains 'overall_pass: true'; (c) condition contains 'state: "Passed"'; (d) criteria_included === 0. The condition leads with markers, not the path, so a tail-side slice cannot strip them.

goal.test.ts `checkCondition (unit)` describe block has a `does not match 'concatenate rubrix.json'` test asserting `checkCondition('Verify that we did not concatenate rubrix.json output ... overall_pass must be true.')` returns zero `filesystem read`-flagged issues. Adjacent positive tests confirm `cat rubrix.json` is still rejected and the combined cap+forbidden case returns both issues at once.

goal.test.ts pathological-cases block contains a `produces deterministic hash when artifacts are undefined` test asserting synthesizeCondition called with `{version, intent, state}` (no rubric/matrix/plan keys) returns the same `derived_from_contract_hash` as synthesizeCondition called with `{..., rubric: undefined, matrix: undefined, plan: undefined}`. Both hashes match /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.

`jq -r .version .claude-plugin/plugin.json` prints `1.5.0`; `jq -r .version cli/package.json` prints `1.5.0`. `claude plugin validate .` exits 0 with no schema warnings. `rg -n '1\.4\.[12]|v1\.4\.[12]' README.md CLAUDE.md PLUGIN-README.md VERIFICATION.md docs/extensible-plan.md` returns zero hits in surface-level claims (historical change-log entries are allowed when they cite a tagged release).

`node cli/bin/rubrix.js validate rubrix.json` exits 0. `node cli/bin/rubrix.js state get rubrix.json` prints `PlanLocked`. rubrix.json contains `version: "1.5.0"`, `locks: {rubric: true, matrix: true, plan: true}`, `state: "PlanLocked"`, no `scores` array, no `goal` block. Each of rubric/matrix/plan carries `.clarity` with a score ≥ its threshold and `forced: false`.

After dogfood reaches PlanLocked, run `node ~/.claude/plugins/cache/rubrix/rubrix/1.4.2/cli/bin/rubrix.js validate rubrix.json` (installed v1.4.2 plugin CLI). Exit 0 with stdout matching `rubrix.json: valid`. `cmp` byte-equality of rubrix.json before and after both worktree + installed CLI validate runs.

`cd cli && npm test` stdout summary matches `Test Files\s+(\d+)\s+passed` with capture ≥ 63 (61 baseline post-PR-#2 plus version-v15 + goal-schema). `Tests\s+(\d+)\s+passed` capture ≥ 635 (614 baseline plus ≥21 new cases). Zero `failed|skipped` occurrences in the summary line. Total elapsed time under 10 seconds.

`cd cli && npm run typecheck` exits 0. Combined stdout+stderr emits zero lines matching `\.ts\(\d+,\d+\):\s+error TS\d+`. Helper interface GoalArtifact (`cli/src/core/contract.ts`) is exported and consumed elsewhere only through the `RubrixContract.goal?` field.

steps.action: Edit cli/schemas/rubrix.schema.json: append a `goal` property to the top-level `properties` block (after `lock_history`) as an object with `required:['condition','max_chars']`, `additionalProperties:false`, and the four sub-properties described in the criterion (condition string 1..4000, max_chars integer const 4000, optional suggested_condition string ≤4000, optional derived_from_contract_hash matching /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/). Do NOT add a new allOf branch — top-level stays free of additionalProperties:false so v1.4 CLIs accept it.

Edit cli/src/core/version.ts: declare `const V1_5 = "1.5.0";` next to V1_2/V1_3/V1_4 and export `isV15Plus(c)` mirroring isV14Plus. Add cli/tests/version-v15.test.ts with the 12 cases described in row-isv15plus-helper.

Edit cli/src/core/contract.ts: extend `RubrixContract` with optional `goal?: GoalArtifact`. Define `export interface GoalArtifact { condition: string; max_chars: 4000; suggested_condition?: string; derived_from_contract_hash?: string }`. Keep ajv as the runtime source of truth — the TypeScript type is for ergonomics, ajv validates structural constraints.

Add cli/tests/goal-schema.test.ts with the 9 schema test cases from row-schema-goal-additive (without-goal, with-goal, max_chars wrong, condition too long, empty condition, missing max_chars, unknown property under goal, malformed hash, v1.4 + goal fail-open).

Edit .claude-plugin/plugin.json `version` to `1.5.0`. Edit cli/package.json `version` to `1.5.0`. Run `claude plugin validate .` and confirm exit 0. No documentation changes are required in this PR — the 5 docs already point at v1.5 surface per PR #1.

Rewrite root rubrix.json from the v1.4 Passed snapshot to a v1.5.0 PlanLocked snapshot focused on the /goal integration surface. Preserve evaluation_policy + drift_policy fields (PR #4 will refresh them after the cascade run); drop the v1.3 scores[] array; replace rubric/matrix/plan content with the v1.5 PR #3 criteria/rows/steps; set state=PlanLocked and locks={rubric:true,matrix:true,plan:true}.

Run `node cli/bin/rubrix.js validate rubrix.json` (worktree CLI) and confirm exit 0. Run `node cli/bin/rubrix.js state get rubrix.json` and confirm stdout is `PlanLocked`. Run the installed v1.4.2 plugin CLI on the same byte-equal file and confirm exit 0 (fail-open invariant).
